mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 56 degrees over at Badger Prairie County Park, with the waxing gibbous moon still visible.

The City of Verona has two important updates. First, they are hiring an Engineering Technician for municipal and utility projects. Second, the council has approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates to cover rising maintenance costs, which will impact quarterly bills for residents.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can check out live music at Bailey's Run or Lake Lou-ee, or take the kids to the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Tomorrow, look for yoga sessions at Insight Wellness.

Regarding the weekly police report, on Friday, August 15, an officer conducted a traffic stop involving a 44-year-old woman who had fallen asleep at the wheel, resulting in an arrest for her first O W I.
Today is the perfect day for some Caramel Cashew, our Culver's flavor of the day. They are currently closed but will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
